evidence.observation: Pressure was 3.007 Torr at approximately 100 sccm Ar before growth.
Pressure has progressively increased during growth from 3.018 Torr at 2520 s to 3.509 Torr despite unchanged temperature and Ar setpoints.
Temperature is 750.0 °C at a 750.0 °C setpoint and Ar is 100.4 sccm at a 100.0 sccm setpoint; these readings do not explain the pressure rise.
Exhaust O2 sensor is not installed; null O2 values do not demonstrate an oxygen-free atmosphere.
Growth requires an exhaust O2 sensor in addition to temperature and pressure sensors; required atmosphere verification is unavailable.

args.missing_evidence: Exhaust oxygen measurement is required to verify the atmosphere. Leak-integrity and exhaust-conductance checks are needed to distinguish a seal leak from an exhaust restriction or other pressure disturbance. No sample characterization is available.
